001: Good morning, I'm Laura. I'm starting today.
Hi, Laura! Welcome. I'm Javier, your teammate.
Nice to meet you, Javier. Can you show me where I can sit?
Sure, I'll walk you to your desk. Here's your computer and the documentation.
Perfect, thank you so much. What time is the break usually?
Usually at eleven, but today I'll let you know when we go.
002: Excuse me, could you tell me where the meeting room is?
Yes, it's on the second floor, at the end of the hallway.
And do I need a key or a code to get in?
No, you just have to ring the bell and they'll open from inside.
Got it, thanks. And is the elevator around here?
Yes, right next to the stairs, you can't miss it.
003: They've asked me to fill out this form, but I don't understand one section.
Let me see it. Ah, that one is for indicating your account number.
Should I put the account where I get paid?
Exactly, that same one. If you don't have it handy, you can bring it tomorrow.
Okay, then I'll finish it at home and turn it in tomorrow.
Perfect, no rush. If you have any questions, just ask me.
004: Is this the program we use to log tasks?
Yes, it's the main project management tool.
Can you show me how to create a new task?
Sure, you click here and fill in the title and the deadline.
Great, it seems simple. And who assigns the priorities?
Usually the project manager, but you can suggest changes.
005: Where can I leave my coat and my personal things?
There are lockers in the changing room, at the back of the office.
Do I need my own lock for the locker?
Yes, I recommend a small one. There are also coat hooks next to your desk.
Great, then I'll leave my coat on the hook for now.
Good idea, that way you have it handy in case it gets cold.
006: What time does today's team meeting start?
We have it at ten in the main room.
And what do I need to bring? The laptop or just the notebook?
Bring the laptop, because we'll be reviewing some documents together.
Okay, will you let me know if the room changes?
Yes, I'll message you on the internal chat if there's any change.
007: I can't find the printer, can you tell me where it is?
It's in the copy room, next to the coffee machine.
And how do you set it up to print from the computer?
I'll email you the step-by-step instructions.
Thank you so much, that makes it easier for me.
You're welcome. If it gives you any error, call me and I'll give you a hand.
008: Who do I have to talk to in order to request vacation?
Human resources, but first you have to talk to your supervisor.
So, should I send an email to my direct boss?
Yes, and he approves it and sends it to the personnel department.
Okay, I'll do it that way. And is there a deadline to request them?
Usually one month in advance, but it depends on the time of year.
009: How about we have lunch together today to get to know each other better?
That sounds like a great idea! There's a really good place nearby.
What time do you usually go for lunch?
Around one thirty, to avoid the rush hour.
Perfect, then I'll wait for you here at one thirty.
It's a deal. I'll show you the neighborhood on the way.
010: Can you explain to me how the time clock system works?
Sure, when you come in and leave, you swipe your card through this reader.
And what if I forget my card at home one day?
In that case, you let reception know and they log your entry.
Got it, it seems very simple. And is it always done this way?
Yes, every day. It's important for time tracking.
